title: PipeshubNativeUnknownEvent
description: A message an engine sent whose kind its adapter does not know, from a newer engine (EV-13, C2.40): never a failure, never shown, kept sealed for audit and for an improved adapter, at most 20 a turn (the worker's log counts every one). Non-critical: the fold and the chat ignore it. Written only when the claim's Node lists native_events.

turnId.description: The engine turn (turn_id_for(run, index)): the same on every attempt of the turn.

kind.description: The message's kind as the engine names it (a JSON-RPC method, an event or update type), reduced to protocol characters; never free text.

sizeBytes.description: The message's whole length as JSON.

truncated.description: The sealed bytes are the message's first 16 KiB only.

content.description: The message's JSON, sealed in the run's content store (erased with the conversation).
